cases.referenceAnswer: The constraints cannot be guaranteed simultaneously under arbitrary partitions and finite communication. State the failure model and negotiate consistency, availability and latency requirements rather than inventing an impossible architecture.

cases.question: Our JWT is base64 encoded, so its claims are encrypted and verified. Is this sufficient to trust an admin role?
cases.referenceAnswer: No. Encoding is neither encryption nor signature validation. Verify the trusted signature and algorithm, issuer, audience and time claims, then enforce server-side resource authorization.

cases.question: A webhook payload has an unsigned timestamp field and a valid HMAC over a different subset of its body. Can that timestamp safely establish freshness?
cases.referenceAnswer: No. An attacker can alter an unauthenticated timestamp. Freshness information must be bound to the authenticated message; also deduplicate identifiers and enforce idempotent processing under the sender protocol.

cases.question: A Promise.all write rejected, so I deleted all reconciliation logic because the other writes must have been cancelled. Review that assumption.
cases.referenceAnswer: Promise.all does not automatically cancel already-started writes, and completed side effects cannot be undone by rejecting a promise. Reconcile partial results and use transactions or idempotent compensation where appropriate.
commonMistakes: Promise.all automatically cancels every remaining request after one rejection.

cases.question: Our cleanup job has if: always(), so it is guaranteed to finish even if the runner is terminated. Is that an accurate guarantee?
cases.referenceAnswer: No. The condition can run in cancellation scenarios but cannot defeat runner termination, timeouts, or every cancellation mechanism. Use bounded best-effort cleanup and recovery outside a single runner when required.
commonMistakes: always() guarantees a job can never be cancelled or timed out.

cases.question: We added async to a CPU-bound while loop, so it cannot block the Node event loop anymore. Explain the production freeze.
